paragraphs: He reports Rabbi Yochanan: Gittin 41a. (Hyman reports that Rashi explains that this was his epithet. See also the entry Ami of Vardina.)[^1]

notes.text: The two whole Davidson Gittin 41a paragraphs name Ami Shapir Na’eh reporting Rabbi Yochanan, followed by the wordplay about the name. The Rashi epithet gloss remains Hyman’s report, without a fresh Rashi collation, an identification with Ami of Vardina, or importation of the surrounding legal material.
